title: CEXAVerifiedCounterpartyCredential
description: CEXA-VerifiedCounterparty - the Travel Rule identity of a member of the Crypto Exchange Association (demo), issued by the Association at validation and renewal, published on the member's DID as a Linked VP and free to verify.
